about.title: About Live Model Test
about.fallback:
Live Model Test helps students prepare with real exam practice. Take timed model tests and live exams in the app, see your marks as soon as results are out, review your answers and find your position on the merit list — in Bangla and English.

Exam timing, scoring and payment checks all run on our server, so every student gets the same fair exam.

downloadPage.title: Download the app
downloadPage.body: Exams are taken in the Live Model Test app for Android. Download it here, or update to the newest version.
apk: Tap the download button above. Your phone saves the file (live-model-test.apk).
Open the file from the notification or from your Downloads folder.
If Android says the install is blocked, tap Settings and allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser (or the Files app), then go back and tap Install.
Open Live Model Test and sign in with your mobile number and password.
updateApk: Download the newest file with the button above.
Open it and tap Install (or Update) over the old app. Your account, results and subscription stay as they are.
If the app showed an update notice, it disappears once the new version is installed.
play: Tap the button above to open Google Play.
Tap Install. To update, tap Update.
Google Play also updates the app by itself when Wi-Fi is available.
downloadPage.safe: Download the app only from this page or from Google Play. We never ask for your password, OTP or payment details by message or link.
